name: @airprompter/agent-telemetry
description: The content-free telemetry spool and its uploader for AirPrompter agents: minute windows as append-only segments (or in memory on serverless), the host budget, and direct-to-object-store upload under a grant.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}))"
